headline.caveat: planned cumulative investment for ~13% ownership on completion of the final $10B tranche (due Oct 1, 2026)

realized_to_date.caveat: $34.6B invested Sept 2024–Feb 2026 (incl. the $22.5B tranche completed Dec 31, 2025) + $10B Apr 1, 2026 + $10B Jul 1, 2026, per SoftBank press releases; some trackers cite lower net figures after syndication to co-investors

nature_md: SoftBank is OpenAI's largest outside shareholder. Via SoftBank Vision Fund 2 it invested an aggregate $34.6B from Sept 2024 through early 2026 (including leading the Apr 2025 $40B round at $300B post and completing an additional $22.5B on Dec 31, 2025), then agreed on Feb 27, 2026 to a further $30B in three $10B tranches (Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1, 2026, accelerable if OpenAI lists) at a $730B pre-money valuation, in preferred shares auto-converting on IPO. Cumulative total on completion: $64.6B for ~13%. The funding is heavily levered: the Jul 1 tranche was drawn on a $10B bridge facility, SoftBank sold its entire NVIDIA stake in late 2025 to fund OpenAI, and it has borrowed ~$10B in margin loans collateralized by the OpenAI stake itself.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Held in SoftBank Vision Fund 2 at fair value through profit and loss — OpenAI markups drive reported Vision Fund gains (a $46B VF gain in FY2025, mainly OpenAI, per CNBC). Funded partly with bridge loans and margin loans against the stake: mark-to-market gains are booked on an asset that is simultaneously collateral.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity financing — no revenue or liability for OpenAI. SoftBank is also OpenAI's ~40% partner in Stargate LLC and developer (via its energy subsidiary) of the Piketon, OH campus, so SoftBank capital reappears on the cost side of OpenAI's compute buildout.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** SoftBank sold its NVIDIA position and is borrowing against unlisted OpenAI shares to fund further OpenAI purchases — concentrated, levered exposure to a single private mark, priced by rounds SoftBank itself leads (Kedrosky/IMF-style circularity). **Bull:** OpenAI's valuation rose from $300B to $852B across SoftBank's entry points, the stake converts at IPO (targeted 2027 at >$1T per Reuters), and SoftBank's FY2025 results already show tens of billions of realized-quality gains.
